instruction: Add the LDAP schema for inetOrgPerson via cn=config
output: ldapadd -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// -f /etc/ldap/schema/inetorgperson.ldif

instruction: Add the cosine schema to OpenLDAP
output: ldapadd -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// -f /etc/ldap/schema/cosine.ldif

instruction: Add the NIS schema to OpenLDAP
output: ldapadd -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// -f /etc/ldap/schema/nis.ldif

instruction: Add the core schema to OpenLDAP
output: ldapadd -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// -f /etc/ldap/schema/core.ldif

instruction: View loaded OpenLDAP schemas
output: ldapsearch -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// -b cn=schema,cn=config dn

instruction: Check the OpenLDAP monitor backend
output: ldapsearch -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// -b cn=monitor

instruction: Check OpenLDAP database statistics
output: ldapsearch -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// -b 'cn=Database 2,cn=Monitor'

instruction: View LDAP connection statistics from monitor
output: ldapsearch -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// -b 'cn=Connections,cn=Monitor'

instruction: View LDAP operations statistics from monitor
output: ldapsearch -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// -b 'cn=Operations,cn=Monitor'

instruction: Enable the statslog overlay in OpenLDAP
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}statslog,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcStatsLog
olcOverlay: statslog
olcStatsLog: /var/log/slapd/stats.log'

instruction: Set up LDAP referral to another server
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcReferral
olcReferral: ldap://backup.example.com'

instruction: Configure OpenLDAP to listen on a specific IP and port
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcServerID
olcServerID: 1 ldap://0.0.0.0:389/'

instruction: Configure slapd to listen on LDAPS port
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcListen
olcListen: ldaps://0.0.0.0:636/'

instruction: Set the slapd thread count
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcThreads
olcThreads: 16'

instruction: Set slapd connection idle timeout
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcIdleTimeout
olcIdleTimeout: 300'

instruction: Set the slapd maximum file descriptors
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcMaxFileDescriptors
olcMaxFileDescriptors: 8192'

instruction: Set slapd write timeout
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcWriteTimeout
olcWriteTimeout: 300'

instruction: Set slapd TCP keepalive settings
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcTCPKeepAlive
olcTCPKeepAlive: 30'

instruction: Limit the size of LDAP search results globally
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcSizeLimit
olcSizeLimit: 500'

instruction: Limit LDAP search time globally
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcTimeLimit
olcTimeLimit: 60'

instruction: Set slapd password hash method globally
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcPasswordHash
olcPasswordHash: {SSHA}'

instruction: Disallow anonymous bind requests in LDAP
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcDisallows
olcDisallows: bind_anon'

instruction: Set slapd to enforce strict RFC 4511 compliance
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcStrict
olcStrict: TRUE'

instruction: Enable the LDAP no-op control for result estimation
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcPlugin
olcPlugin: noop'
